meeting.title: Flock Freight — implementation sync (restart)
meeting.summary: Re-engagement sync after two quiet weeks on the Flock Freight onboarding. Agreed a review of the metric definitions doc, a rebuild of the shipment reporting dashboard with the new lane dimension, and pilot user confirmation.
action_items: Derek to review metric definitions doc and leave comments by June 12
Ines to rebuild shipment reporting dashboard with the lane dimension by June 17
Hannah to confirm pilot user list from the operations team by June 15
key_decisions: Dashboard rebuild waits for the lane dimension rather than shipping and reworking
meeting.notes: First call in two weeks — Derek was heads-down on quarter-end. Momentum needs rebuilding; dates were set deliberately tight.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Good to have you both back. No blame — quarter-end happens — but let's rebuild momentum with a few tight, concrete steps.

transcript.speaker: Derek Chao
transcript.text: Appreciated, and yes, I went dark. Quarter-end reporting ate the whole team. I'm back on this now.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: The thing blocking us is the metric definitions doc — it's been sitting with you since mid-May. Without your comments we can't lock the semantic layer.

transcript.speaker: Derek Chao
transcript.text: That's fair. I'll review the metric definitions doc and leave comments by Friday, June 12th. Realistically it's two hours of work, I just need to sit down with it.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Friday works. Next: the shipment reporting dashboard. You mentioned the lane dimension changed?

transcript.speaker: Derek Chao
transcript.text: Yes — we restructured so every shipment now rolls up to a lane. The current dashboard predates that, so its groupings are wrong.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Then rather than patch it, I'll rebuild the shipment reporting dashboard with the new lane dimension by Wednesday, June 17th.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Ellis
transcript.text: Should we wait for the definitions review before that rebuild, or can they run in parallel?

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Parallel — the lane dimension work doesn't touch the contested metric definitions. If Derek's comments change anything I'll fold it in.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Ellis
transcript.text: Okay. Then on pilot users — the operations team gave me eight names but two are leaving the company. I'll confirm the list of pilot users from the operations team by Monday, June 15th.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Great. And I'd gently suggest we keep this slot weekly even in busy periods — a fifteen-minute check-in beats a two-week gap.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Done. So: comments Friday, pilot list Monday, dashboard Wednesday. Talk next week.
